Dialogs.Dialog: Anegasaki
Pop quiz! What brings good luck if you see it in your first dream of the year？
Let's see... First Fuji, second hawk... What was the last one again？
Number three: eggplant. I've never seen one myself, though. How about you？
I feel like I saw one this year
If it's a dream about going on a date with ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲
Then it'll be a great year. If it's a good year for you, it will be for me too, right？
Well, that's a dream bound to come true! Tell me all about it, okay？
Anegasaki
Achoo！
Catching a cold, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
No, not that, but maybe I should've bundled up a little more.
Want to get something warm to drink somewhere？
...You could always get closer to me.
Thanks, but I'm okay. ...Just that warm thought is more than enough.
Then... can we at least... hold hands？ That way, even a cold day can be fun.
Anegasaki
Seeing plum blossoms reminds me of pickling umeboshi at Grandma's house back in the day.
You know how to make umeboshi, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
I've heard how it's done, but I'm not confident I could do it on my own.
I'd love to try some umeboshi you made, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
You'd make a great wife, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Oh, that's asking a lot... Maybe I'll try making some next time, with Mom showing me how.
I don't think girls who know how to pickle umeboshi are very popular with guys. ...Or do you feel differently？
Anegasaki
The cherry blossoms near school, it felt like the buds just opened, and now they're already in full bloom.
Then we'd better plan our flower viewing soon. Once they bloom, they scatter pretty fast.
Since we're going, instead of a big noisy crowd, how about just the two of us？
I think a big group would be more fun, though.
Of course! That was my plan all along!
Oh, really？ Well, if you say so.
Looking at the cherry blossoms together... That sounds wonderful...
*Yaaawn*...
Anegasaki
Didn't get enough sleep？ You shouldn't be staying up late all the time, you know？
I sleep fine, but I just get so drowsy... It's springtime, after all.
True. When it's warm like this... I get sleepy too.
It's definitely the warm spring weather's fault.
Want to take a nap？
...Maybe. Sounds a bit like an excuse, but we can't really help it, right？
That might be nice. Maybe with a lap pillow？
Anegasaki
Someone in the neighborhood started gardening, and their yard is so pretty.
Huh. Sounds like a stylish hobby.
Their flowerbed is gorgeous, but they said keeping it nice is really tough. ...I kind of want to try it.
I'd love to grow flowers with you too, ●.
Gardening would really suit you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Oh, you're pretty into it？ Doing it together sounds like fun.
Really？ Well, if I do it someday, I'd want my hubby to help out too, you know？
Anegasaki
Before I even realized it, half the year's already over.
Oh, yeah. I didn't even realize until you mentioned it.
Does that mean the last six months were so full, you didn't even notice the time？
All thanks to you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！
I don't think it's been all that fulfilling yet.
You're very welcome♪ Though of course, I feel the exact same way.
...I see. Well, the next six months... let's make them great together.
Anegasaki
Could it be you're still tired from summer break？
Yeah, it's still hot every day, so it doesn't really feel like break is over yet.
I get that, but you need to switch gears soon. Come on, cheer up!
...Alright! Time to get back in gear.
I want ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ to share some of that energy.
That's the spirit! Let's do our best this term too♪
...Oh, you. Sending you my energy... Hiyah! Hehe, how's that？
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Swapped over your wardrobe yet？
● pretty much just took out the uniform. Girls have so many clothes, it must be tough.
It's work, but it feels like a fashion show, so it's fun？
I'm jealous that girls get to be so fashionable.
I want a ticket to that show!
Boys can too, you know... Oh, want me to pick out an outfit for you next time？
Hehe... Well~？ Maybe I'll let only my boyfriend sneak a peek, if the chance comes up.
If it was gonna be this hot every day, I shouldn't have swapped clothes yet.
Anegasaki
In my class too, a lot of people take their jackets off as soon as they get to school.
Right？ Aren't you hot, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ You don't even look like you're sweating.
It is hot, but I think being excited to wear fall clothes wins out for me.
Not breaking a sweat... Just like an actress.
You can put up with anything for fashion, huh.
Not quite, but I couldn't let my boyfriend see me looking all sweaty and messy, right？
Being a girl is hard work, you know.
Hehe, I think lots of girls want to look cute no matter what, though.
...Especially in front of someone special.
Anegasaki
They say during Kannazuki, gods from all across Japan gather in Izumo, right？
Yeah, that's right. ● learned that in classical Japanese class too.
Apparently they hold a meeting about human fate, like who ends up with who.
Huh. I didn't know that was a thing.
Maybe you and I were decided there, too.
Thank you, gods!
You're quite the romantic, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Thank you so much▼ And please keep watching over us, okay？ Hehehe.
You think…… so？ Even with so many people all across Japan, we still found each other.
Don't you think that's really special？
Anegasaki
On my way to school, I saw frost columns in an empty lot. No wonder it's so cold.
Huh, we're getting frost columns already？
It made me feel nostalgic. Didn't you ever stomp on frost columns when you were a kid？
I never have, so I'd like to try.
I did! That takes me back.
Really？ That crunch-crunch feeling is so much fun, you know？
We'd race to see who could find and stomp them first... ...I was kind of a tomboy.
If you could have a pet, what would you want, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？ A cat, after all？ Or maybe a dog？
Anegasaki
Hmm…… Putting aside if I can or not, what I'd want is... a tanuki, maybe？
Is that weird after all？ But with those round eyes and that roly-poly tummy, don't you think they're just adorable？
I hear they're actually pretty vicious, though？
They definitely look cute.
Huh？ But they look so sweet…… Maybe that's why you hardly ever see people keeping them as pets.
I know I can't keep one, but when I see plushies or phone charms, I just end up buying them.
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. The other day, I helped out an acquaintance at a puppy adoption event.
Oh, the one at the park nearby？ Looked like quite a crowd showed up.
Still, just being cute isn't always enough to find people who'll adopt them, you know.
You'd want owners who'll care for them to the very end.
……I wish ● could keep one too.
Yeah. But the new families really thought that through before adopting, so I'm sure they'll be just fine.
Ah, I didn't bring this up to imply anything, you know？
……Still, it makes me happy that you're thinking so seriously about those pups.
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Do you ever talk with friends about what animal someone's like, and stuff like that？
Totally. It's not just looks, it's about their whole vibe, you know？
Then, my vibe is……
What did they say you were？
A tanuki. ……I don't hate it, but what kind of impression do they have of me？
A round image, maybe？
An adorable image, maybe？
Ehh？ I see…… I guess it sounds gentle, and not meant in a bad way, but still……
Maybe I should…… go on a diet……
Right, nobody meant it in a bad way, did they？ That's a relief▼
Anegasaki
Eek!? J-Just now…… in the corner…… a f-frog!
A frog……？ That's just a garden stone over there. It's got moss, so from afar it does look like one, though.
……Really？ Jeez, don't laugh! ……It looked like a real frog to me.
Especially after it rains…… They're always out!
Sorry, sorry. But you know, seeing ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ in a panic is actually pretty fun.
I just found it a bit surprising.
I just thought it was really cute, honestly.
I mean, that slimy green texture... Ugh, no. Just thinking about it gives me the creeps...
Geez, let's just hurry up!
Frogs are the one thing I just can't handle! It's kind of like childhood trauma, or... U-Um... would you mind if I held onto your arm？
Anegasaki
Lately, I've been really into amigurumi. They're like little plushies knit from yarn.
Huh. What kind do you make, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Mostly animals. Bunnies, cats, maybe a tanuki...
I'd love to see them sometime.
So you really do like tanukis after all...
It's easy once you get the hang of it, you know？ Plenty of guys do amigurumi, too...
Oh, want me to teach you sometime？
It's not that I like them so much as... I feel a kind of kinship, maybe？
Like I'm looking at myself.
...Hehe, don't you think？ Like, 'Ponpoko-riiin!' ...Or something.
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, did you put a hold on a new book at the library？
Anegasaki
Yeah... Oh right, you're on the library committee.
Yep. The new release you reserved came in, so if you want to read it, you should probably check it out soon.
Yeah, thanks. Oh, hey. Think our library rep could recommend me a book sometime？
I can give you some recommendations on a day I'm on duty.
I can give you recommendations anytime after school.
Thanks. Be sure to let me know what days you're on duty.
Hehe, that way I'll get to learn your tastes too, so it's two birds with one stone.
Thanks. In that case, we might even get to be all alone together in an empty library.
Hehe, that sounds kind of like a library date, doesn't it？
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Hey, have you ever written a love letter？
Huh？ Where's this coming from all of a sudden？
Well, apparently writing love letters is a big thing at school right now.
Instead of texting？
Yep, handwritten. A hand- written love letter has a warmth that texts just don't have, you know？
Love letters, huh？ That's an old-fashioned trend.
Maybe ● should try writing a love letter too...
I was surprised when I first heard about it too... but it's kind of nice, isn't it？
Pouring your heart into it, handing it over with your heart pounding... Hehe, don't you think that's lovely？
Really？ That's to me, right？ Hehe, I'll be waiting for that letter full of all your feelings, okay？
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. So the other day, we made curry in home ec class.
So that's why the whole school smelled like curry... The guys in our class had their stomachs rumbling the entire time.
Hehe, maybe we should apologize for that. If it weren't for class, I would've loved to treat you to some.
Invite me next time you have cooking class!
I'd love for you to make it at ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s place next time.
Fufu, you sure know how to flatter me. Next time we have class, maybe I'll sneak you an invitation.
At my place？ Fufu, then maybe 'newlywed Nene' should cook up some curry filled with love, and wait for her darling husband to come home？
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Does your class ever have bag checks？
Yeah. We get surprise checks, and guys who bring manga often get it confiscated.
They do them in my class sometimes too, but nobody really likes them.
I don't think being too strict is good either, though...
I wish they'd trust us to be responsible, ●.
I guess surprise checks can't really be helped.
Yeah, I think that would be much better, too.
Still, plenty of people break the rules anyway... Maybe we should talk it out as a class once.
...You're not bringing anything against the rules, are you？
Like... dirty magazines, or whatever boys like. ...You haven't brought any, right？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, is something on your mind？ You've looked kind of down for a while now.
Anegasaki
A friend of mine had a fight with her boyfriend, and she's really down. She asked me for advice...
I see. What caused it？
She hung out with girlfriends and totally neglected him, so he got really mad. I know it's her fault too, but...
It's hard to strike a balance, isn't it？
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, are you okay spending all your time with just ●？
Exactly. So I suggested she talk things through with him again, but...
I really hope they make up.
I've never really thought about that.
When I'm with my friends, they worry about me instead: 'Shouldn't you be on a date with your boyfriend？'
So there's no need to worry, ▼.
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. My friends said they want to see a picture of you... Would that be okay？
Huh？ Why do they want a picture of ●...？
At lunch, everyone started bragging about boyfriends. I'm not really into that... but I couldn't say no, so I promised I'd take one.
You can take as many photos as you want!
Could the one who really wants a photo be ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
Geez, I'm actually pretty embarrassed here. But if you're okay with it, so am I.
Well... okay, maybe that thought crossed my mind a little, but...
Maybe I shouldn't set it as my phone wallpaper？
Anegasaki
People come to me for advice a lot... Why is it always me, though？
Well, the truth is, you're really dependable.
Yeah... Once an image sticks, it's not easy to shake.
How about acting clumsy on purpose?!
I think you're fine just being yourself, though.
Hmm, that's tough... Like flipping a plate over at Dixie's...? No, I can't do that.
...You mean I'm fine just the way I am？
That makes me happy. But... if I could, instead of being 'everyone's Nene-san', I'd rather be your Nene, you know？ Fufu!
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, are you in a good mood today, by any chance？
Anegasaki
Hehe... Can you tell？ Actually, yesterday at the market, I finally found them— those limited-edition shichimi yuzu cough drops.
Shichimi and yuzu...？ That's a pretty wild combo for candy... Is it good？
They look like normal yuzu drops, but every so often you get a kick that's surprisingly soothing. Wanna try one？
I'd like to try one. Gotta brace myself first.
I think ● will pass...
I don't think you need to be that cautious, though. You might even get hooked？
You didn't need to hold back. Here, I'll give you a melon cough drop instead.
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. What do you think of guys who cook as a hobby？
Hmm... Kinda cool, I guess？
Hehe. I was just thinking it'd be fun to cook together, just the two of us. Don't you think so？
I'd rather a girl who can cook make it for me, honestly.
It sounds like a lot of fun if it's with you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Geez, guys need to know how to cook these days, too. I know! Next time, I'll teach you how to hold a kitchen knife. Ready for special training？
Cooking might seem hard, but once you actually start, it gets more and more fun.
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Yesterday, I ended up buying detergent off TV shopping.
TV shopping... As in, 'Hey Bob, what kind of product are you showing us today？' That kind of thing？
That's it! Once it arrives, I can't wait to make the whole house sparkle.
You really like cleaning, don't you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
I'd love it if you cleaned ●'s room, too.
I mean, watching all the dirt come off until it sparkles just feels so good, right？
Whenever I spot a mess, I just can't help wanting to clean it up right away.
...Guess it's just a habit.
Clean your own room yourself! ...is what I'd like to say, but if it's your room, maybe I just might head over？
Oh, and make sure to hide anything you don't want your girlfriend to see... Hehe.
Anegasaki
A friend of mine told me that to make a relationship last, it's important to get into your boyfriend's hobbies.
Having hobbies in common makes talking easier, I guess, but still...
Lately, I've been thinking that as your girlfriend, I'd like to understand your hobbies a little better.
The thought's plenty. No point if you're forcing it.
If anything, I'd rather understand ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ better.
Aw, you're so sweet. And it's true, forcing yourself to match is kind of weird for a couple anyway.
Oh, is that how it is？ I might not go easy on you. Hehe♪
Anegasaki
One of my underclassmen came to tell me she made the starting volleyball lineup.
Huh, so the underclassmen really look up to you, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
We just happened to cross paths. I want to get her something to celebrate, without going overboard. What do you think I should get her？
Maybe something practical for club, like a towel？
She might feel obligated, though.
Oh, good idea. A plain towel feels a bit dull, so I'll embroider her initials on it.
Right. I'll congratulate her first, and ask about gifts while we're talking.
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. You see regional goods a lot, but how do you actually buy something like that？
Hmm, I wonder. Is there something specific you want？
You know how much I love cough drops, right？ Well, apparently they have regional flavors!
Couldn't you just buy those online, then？
Want to try visiting a candy wholesale district？
Oh, right! You can buy pretty much anything online these days. Hehe, that's a relief.
There's a place like that...？ That sounds like fun. A date there could be nice, too♪
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. I found a weird cough drop at the convenience store. It says it tastes like a first kiss.
Huh... What does that taste like？
A little sweet and sour, it melts right away, and leaves a fresh aftertaste... Something like that, I think.
Huh, really.
Hehe, our first kiss... I wonder what that tasted like.
Want to try it again？
Come to think of it, maybe it was sweet and sour.
Huh？ Right here, right now？ That's... oh, no way! I mean, even if we did, it wouldn't be our first kiss! So, nope! Denied!
Hehe, your face is bright red! Then if you have one of those drops, you can relive it anytime, right？
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Did you know the cafe in front of the station is doing an all-you-can-eat cake buffet？
Oh yeah？ I'm kind of jealous how easily girls can go to places like that together.
It's a girl's privilege, after all. Though even with all-you-can-eat, I didn't think I could eat that much...
Like, five slices each？
Actually... they were small, but I ate ten of them. I really need to work on my diet now.
A cake buffet, huh... I'd kind of like to go too, ●.
You're not fat at all, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
There were actually quite a few couples there, you know.
Ah, well, my diet... Yep! I guess I can take a break from it when I'm on a date with you.
If I let my guard down, the fat goes straight to places you can't see... Hey! Forget you heard that!
What do you usually do at home these days？
Anegasaki
Hmm, I guess I've been looking at floor plans. You know, like the ones in newspaper flyers？
Like for new houses and condos？
Yeah. Looking at floor plans and imagining living in a house like that someday... like, 'This'll be my husband's room, and this is the kids' room.' It's so fun.
You're a floor plan nerd!
I'd be really happy if I was in that daydream too, ●.
Just from one single layout, you can imagine so many stories. Hehe, it's kind of like playing house when I was little.
'Welcome home, dear. Would you like dinner？ Or maybe a bath first？' Hehe, wouldn't it be wonderful if we really talked like that someday...？
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Lately I've been wanting to expand my cooking repertoire, but...
Did the manager ask you for new ideas again？
No... It's not that, I just want to get better at cooking. I'm actually working on something right now.
Don't mind if I do!
I'll be waiting to hear the good news, then.
Geez, don't rush me! I want my boyfriend to eat something truly delicious, so just a little longer. Okay？
Yes, sir! Please wait just a moment, ▼! Hehe♪
I'm always thinking this, but you're basically perfect at school and at work, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
Anegasaki
Huh... That's not true at all. Just the other day, I spilled coffee right in front of a customer...
At Dixie's？ Did they get mad at you？
Luckily, none got on him. And the customer was such a gentleman about it. He just smiled and told me it was totally fine.
Makes me feel a little closer to ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲.
I might get jealous, you know.
Geez, don't feel relieved over something like that! I make mistakes too, and I get down enough to want someone to comfort me.
Geez... Like I always tell you, the only one I love is you. Don't go getting weird ideas! Bad!
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲。
Hm？ What？
What is it？ Did I do something, ●？
Yeah, I love you so much, ▼. Hehe♪
What is it？ Hehe, just wanted to say your name, ▼~
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Have you ever wondered where your name came from？
Uh, well, let's see...
Come to think of it, I've never really thought about it.
I was curious, so I asked my parents once.
Aw, that's too bad. I really wanted to know~
Really？ Tell me, tell me!
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲, could you try calling ●？
Anegasaki
▲主人公＊▲. Is this okay？
Yeah, I'm so happy!
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲！
Yes, I'm happy too, ▼.
Yes, darling？ Hehehe♪
